calculation.description: Fade the completed day's open-to-close move, normalized by prior 20-day ATR, blended with inverse close location value. All inputs are from the completed observation day and the ATR is shifted one day to prevent leakage.

validation.regime_notes: Passed the benchmark daily paper IC and ICIR gates, but the effective sample is concentrated in 2026 and the cross-sectional universe is only 15 instruments. High correlation to an existing range-expansion intraday artifact warrants deterministic deduplication review.
